question: What topics are to be treated in the twentieth chapter?
premises: The twentieth chapter deals with preparation ending in the examination of eligibility.
It also treats the rite of the balance.
These form the whole subject matter to be spoken there.
inference: The twentieth chapter will present the preparation culminating in eligibility-examination and the rite of the balance.
uncertainties: The exact ritual sense of tulāvidhiḥ may be more specific than 'rite of the balance'.
plain_english: In the twentieth chapter, the full subject matter will be the preparation that culminates in examining eligibility, together with the rite of the balance.
